# 74157 - Quadruple 2-line-to-1-line data selector/multiplexer (74158 has inverted output)

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74157.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74157.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 31 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74157 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74157.png) | ![74157 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74157.png) | ![74157 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74157.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 1 | SELECT | input |  |  | low selects the A inputs, high the B inputs |
| 15 | STROBE | enable | low |  | controls pins 4, 7, 9, 12; when not enabled: low |
| 2 | 1A | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1B | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | 1Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 5 | 2A | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | 2B | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | 2Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 11 | 3A | input |  |  |  |
| 10 | 3B | input |  |  |  |
| 9 | 3Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 14 | 4A | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | 4B | input |  |  |  |
| 12 | 4Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1Y = STROBE' AND ((SELECT' AND 1A) OR (SELECT AND 1B)) | 1Y follows 1A when SELECT is low and 1B when SELECT is high; STROBE high forces it low. |
| 7 | 2Y = STROBE' AND ((SELECT' AND 2A) OR (SELECT AND 2B)) | 2Y follows 2A when SELECT is low and 2B when SELECT is high; STROBE high forces it low. |
| 9 | 3Y = STROBE' AND ((SELECT' AND 3A) OR (SELECT AND 3B)) | 3Y follows 3A when SELECT is low and 3B when SELECT is high; STROBE high forces it low. |
| 12 | 4Y = STROBE' AND ((SELECT' AND 4A) OR (SELECT AND 4B)) | 4Y follows 4A when SELECT is low and 4B when SELECT is high; STROBE high forces it low. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | The datasheet's '158 types are only 'LS158 and 'S158 (inverted outputs; with STROBE high their outputs are high); no plain 74158 is listed. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Data | Y | PLH | 9 | 14 |
| Data | Y | PHL | 9 | 14 |
| Strobe | Y | PLH | 13 | 20 |
| Strobe | Y | PHL | 14 | 21 |
| Select | Y | PLH | 15 | 23 |
| Select | Y | PHL | 18 | 27 |

## Notes

This file describes the 74157 (true outputs).
